objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, or other controlled content that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code identifying the document type combined with a consecutive number (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid indicating strategic vs. operational scope.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the document, updated upon each release cycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the document (e.g., editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is considered valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus the validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time period (default 3 years) after which the document must be reviewed for continued validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable time period (default 10 years) for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The area or scope of applicability of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications associated with or referenced by the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies for which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Organizational areas where the document applies.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original file format of the document content (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The original language in which the document is authored.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person registered as the primary author responsible for the document.

attributes.name: co_authors
attributes.description: Additional persons with write permissions on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Persons assigned to review the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Persons authorized to approve and release the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling which readers may view the document.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute controlling email notification distribution when a new version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute controlling acknowledgement-based distribution upon release.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is automatically released with the release of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment, subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the attachment, following the main document's release process statuses.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object attached to a document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly via property switches.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changes to an existing released document, created and managed independently without affecting the document's content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and archive it, triggering a workflow for review and approval of the document's suspension.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring its validity and permissions.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users defined in the system for assigning collective read or change authorizations and distribution roles.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person in the system who can be assigned roles and permissions for document management activities.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The system role assigned to the user such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Translator.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity within the company to which documents and processes can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process managed in the system that can be linked to documents and procedural instructions.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object in the system that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: An IT application registered as master data in the system that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list maintained per document specifying user groups and persons who receive the document via email notification or acknowledgement workflow upon release.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process controlling the approval steps (Creator, Review, Release) with electronic signatures and email notifications.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow task, documented per released version.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational unit in a multi-client system where documents can be made visible or restricted.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific user interface view displaying relevant documents, tasks, and evaluations for the logged-in user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation or search function providing filtered information about documents based on selection parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classification of the report such as Status Report, Document Monitoring, or Acknowledgement Status.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation by a user that they have read and noted a distributed document, tracked and summarized for authors and key roles.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: An author creates a new document object in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type and optionally a template.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: An author or co-author maintains the metadata and attributes of a document in the properties dialog.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: An author or co-author edits the content of a document using the integrated editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The system automatically converts the saved document content to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: An author or co-author initiates the 3-step release workflow (Creator, Review, Release) for a document.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the Creator step of the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and formal correctness and completes the review workflow step with an electronic signature.

evts.name: reject_document_review
evts.description: A reviewer rejects the document during the review step, causing the workflow to be canceled for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document by completing the release workflow step with an electronic signature.

evts.name: reject_document_release
evts.description: A releaser rejects the document during the release step, causing the workflow to be canceled for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: The system automatically publishes the document after release, making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: An author creates a new editing version of a released document to make changes, retaining all data from the previous version.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An author adds an attachment (controlled sub-document) to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An author modifies an existing attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An author adds supplementary additional information to a document, which is published directly without a release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An author deletes additional information from a document without affecting the main document's version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A user with author rights creates a change proposal for an existing released document without affecting the document's content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal, notifying the creator and removing the proposal from the document display.

evts.name: generate_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_document_validity
evts.description: A releaser (or author, reviewer, releaser in the extended process) confirms additional validity of a document, updating the Valid Until date and deleting the request.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request for override to invalidate a document and start the archiving workflow.

evts.name: declare_document_out_of_force
evts.description: The releaser (or the 3-step workflow participants) declares the document out of force, revoking all rights except archive group and starting the archive duration.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator of the reactivation request confirms reactivation, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata, permissions, and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: The system sends email notifications to users and user groups on the distribution list when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_document_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: The system sends email requests to users and user groups on the distribution list to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a distributed document via the workflow task.

evts.name: assign_user_to_user_group
evts.description: A technical administrator assigns a user to a user group for authorization and distribution purposes.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates the released content of a document into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is checked and released with workflow support, making it visible to authorized readers in the corresponding language.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: The system physically deletes archived documents after the archive duration has expired.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: A user generates an evaluation report with filtered information about documents based on selection parameters and criteria.

o2o.description: An Attachment belongs to and is controlled by a main Document.
Additional Info is supplementary content attached to a Document.
A Change Proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific Document.
A Request for Validity Extension is linked to the Document whose validity is being checked.
A Request for Override is created for a specific Document to be invalidated.
A Request for Reactivation references the archived Document to be reactivated.
A Document can be created based on one of the defined Document Templates for its document type.
A Document can be linked to a Process for process-specific filing and reference.
A Document can be linked to an Organizational Unit.
A Document can be linked to a Risk.
A Document can reference IT Applications as master data.
A Document can reference other Documents, including local extensions in multi-client setups.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document to control its distribution.
A Distribution List contains User Groups whose members receive the document.
A Distribution List can contain individual Users as direct recipients.
A User can be assigned to one or more User Groups for authorization and distribution purposes.
A Document can be configured to be visible or hidden in specific Clients in a multi-client system.
An Acknowledgement is a confirmation record associated with a specific Document version.
An Acknowledgement is performed by a specific User.
